title: PDNO Control Benchmark: Frozen Code and Summary Results for Action-Factorized Neural-Operator Control
description: Software and summary-data companion to "Control Quality and Tail Latency of an Action-Factorized Neural Operator: A Frozen PDE Benchmark" by Hyojin Park and Jinhong Yang. Contains the frozen Burgers/heat numerical, observation, controller and learning implementation, historical runner scripts, CPU tests, executed configuration, audited summary tables and reproducible publication figures. The evaluated implementation did not achieve its proposed control-quality/tail-latency hypothesis. This release reproduces figures from summaries and supports CPU implementation checks. Full trajectory arrays, request-level timing arrays and model checkpoints are not included; it is not a complete from-raw audit or retraining archive. The paper is a submission draft, not an accepted publication. Funding: National IT Industry Promotion Agency (NIPA), Korea government (MSIT), Development of Adaptive Physics-aware Synthetic Data Generation Technology, No.RS-2026-25621689.
